description: Looking for people interested in space and space related devices.
summary:
Our project is an interactive learning website. This project enables someone to learn about real NASA missions, and gain an insight into spacecraft engineering. We have created a website which includes information about four NASA spacecraft: MAVEN, Opportunity Rover, Mars Pathfinder and Phoenix Mars Lander. The website includes information about the purpose of the mission, design, scientific findings, challenges and how they have influenced future exploration.

Our project helps to solve the NASA Space Apps Challenge by simplifying complex space missions. We explain how different spacecrafts are designed to complete certain scientific goals. Comparing these missions helps us to learn about the engineering decisions, technologies and challenges that go into exploring Mars.

This project is important as it makes space exploration more accessible and will encourage students to become interested in STEM subjects (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics). It demonstrates how NASA missions help us understand more about Mars and get us ready for future exploration.
details:
Our project is an educational website called Space Mission Design. It provides information about 4 of NASA’s spacecrafts; MAVEN, Opportunity Rover, Mars Pathfinder and Phoenix Mars Lander. The page will show what the spacecraft is used for, how they are designed, what they have discovered, and any issues faced.

The website was created using HTML, CSS, Python and Flask. We wanted to create an easy to use, interactive, space themed website to help us understand space exploration.

Our project solves the problem by showing how different spacecrafts are designed for different missions. We focused on creating a simple, informative and attractive website. We hope that our website can inspire students to learn more about NASA and pursue their interests in STEM.
